HG18-wa:
Come all the way back

In order to exit from the session you will need to reverse how you entered, for example if you floated then feel yourself gain weight again, if you shrank then go back to your normal size. If you went back to a younger state or came out as different parts of yourself then make sure you are in the here and now, whole, in your body, and recognise yourself to be an adult in control of your own body. If you travelled somewhere to enter trance then come back the same way. Make sure that you only keep what you want to keep.

Script: Come back bringing with you only what you want to bring back into your conscious life. Nothing else needs to come back at this time. You are now back in the room, back in your body, back in your day. My instructions to you now are complete. You may choose to adopt this intention in your normal life or this cue at a later date. Both of these things will not continue this session. You are back to your normal self, in your body, with your adult judgement.

1, feeling the weight of your body again 2, returning to your normal breathing pattern 3, aware of your surroundings and where you are 4, moving your fingers, toes, shoulders and eyes 5, opening your eyes back to normal life, completely present and totally normal. The session is now over.

When you open your eyes think to yourself what day or date it is, look to your left and to your right, look at something far away and something close. Move your body about a bit before getting up. Make sure you are back to normal. Don’t just assume that because you counted back it worked. It’s all good and well thinking you are out when you really want to be out but check you actually are out before you get up. Note down what happened, if anything, and what you are going to do about it. Then go and do something normal to fully re-integrate back into normal life.

If your recording cuts out before the exit script plays say to yourself that the recording has cut out and the session is over. Then open your eyes, say where you are, what day it is, push down with your feet or hands, move about, look around and count yourself back using the above 5 step process.

Note: If you are using a recording to help you sleep then it doesn’t matter if it leaves you asleep or in a quiet state. This advice is for waking recordings only. Waking recordings should never leave you in a state, with a role, with lowered judgement, with lowered ability to move, blank, with a non-specific reset word or in any other way that will keep you in an altered state for an indefinite period.

HG18-wb:
Come all the way back

Make sure to reverse anything you've done to alter your state when you come out of it. If you've floated, make sure you regain your weight (of your choice, of course). If you've shrunk, grow to your normal size again. If you've regressed or met parts, make sure you come back to feeling complete in the here and now and acknowledge that your body belongs to you and is under control of the adult mind. If you've gone somewhere, make sure you go back the same way. Etcetera. Make sure that the only things you bring out with you are the ones you want to.

Here is a generic bring-back that you can use: "When I come out of this session, I will only bring with me that which is useful to me in my everyday life right now. Anything else I will bring with me at a later date, when I am better able to integrate it. When I come out of this session, I will be coming back to the room I am in now, and to the day in which I am participating in this session now. All instructions you have given me to carry me deeper in this session or to keep me in this state are now finished. The only instruction I will take with me into my everyday life, or the only cue I will use to take me into this state in the future, is the one I consciously choose to. When I come out of this session, I will be me, in my body, with my adult judgment."

Then count up, using the five steps listed above: 1...feel your body again, feel your weight (of your choice). 2...feel your breathing return to normal. 3...become aware of your surroundings, know where you are. 4...wiggle your fingers and toes, move your shoulders and your eyes. 5...open your eyes, back in the here and now, feeling normal and clear. This session is now over."

When you come out, remind yourself what day (or date) it is. Look to your left and your right. Look at something near, and something far. Move around a bit before getting up. Get up when you feel ready. Make sure you're truly oriented and alert. Don't just assume it because you've done the count. Take mental note of anything that has come up for you and any actions you need to take regarding it. Then go on and do something normal.

If your recording cuts out for some reason, you can say to yourself, "The recording has stopped and the session is over," and then do the above on your own.

Note: If you're going to sleep to a recording, it's fine to go to sleep or just to remain resting quietly at the end of it. But if you're coming out, you should not leave yourself in an altered state, including leaving yourself in a role, with judgment lowered, with movements impaired, blank, with a non-specific reset word, or indefinitely.

HG18-wc:
Come all the way back

In order to come out of a session, you should do the opposite of what you did to enter. If you floated or went to a place, come back down using the same method. If you decided to have a certain weight as you came down, use that weight when you land. If you made yourself smaller, go back to your normal size. If you went to a place where you met a younger self or parts of yourself, make sure to tell them that you are whole now, this is your body, and you will be using adult judgement, etc. If you traveled in some way, then come back the same way you went. Be sure that you are bringing back only what you intended to bring back from the session.

You may want to say, “I am bringing back with me only what I need at this time. All other things will be safely stored until I need them. I am coming back now to this place, to my body, and to normal living, one honest action at a time. Except for (whatever you may be keeping for ordinary life or cues for practicing in the future, if you are keeping any), nothing I have heard will cause me to go deeper or stay in the session.”

Begin to count yourself out: “1. Coming back now into your body, with whatever weight you choose to have. 2. Coming back to your normal breathing pattern. 3. Coming back to hearing all of the sounds around you right now in (wherever you are). Start moving your fingers and toes, your shoulders, your eyes. 4. Still coming back. 5. Open your eyes feeling normal, and knowing that the session is over.”

Say what day it is or the date, if you need to, and look to the left and the right. Look at something close and something far away. Feel free to move around a bit before getting up. Get up when you feel like it. Make sure that you are alert and oriented to the here and now. Just because you counted doesn’t mean that you are out. Take note of things that you may or may not need to do, if anything came up in the session that you need to act on. Then go about your normal activities.

If you are listening to a recording and it stops before it is supposed to, then just say to yourself that it has stopped and the session is over. Use the above method to bring yourself out by opening your eyes, saying where you are, saying what day it is, pushing down with your feet or hands, moving around, looking around, and/or using the 5 step method above. Don’t just sit there waiting for the recording to start up again to “let you out.”

NOTE: If you are going to sleep to a recording, it is fine to let the recording put you to sleep or leave you in a quiet place. However, a recording for use while awake should not leave you in a role, with lowered judgement, impaired movement capabilities, blank, with an undefined reset word, etc.
